question: The SAFE (SIDBI Assistance to Facilitate Emergency response against Corona Virus) scheme, launched by SIDBI (Small Industries Development Bank of India) in March 2020, provided loans at an interest rate of ________ per annum.
solution:
The correct answer is __**5%**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The SAFE (SIDBI Assistance to Facilitate Emergency response against Coronavirus) scheme was introduced by the Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) in March 2020. 
 
• This scheme was specifically designed to support micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in their efforts to manufacture essential goods needed to combat the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• SIDBI provides loans to MSEs at a low rate of interest of 5% within 48 hours and thereby making it easier for them to facilitate tasks that can help tackle the pandemic.
 
• The maximum loan amount offered under the scheme was ₹50 lakh.
 
• The repayment period was up to 36 months (3 years).
 
• Included a moratorium period of 6 months during which businesses didn’t have to pay installments.
 
• MSMEs already producing COVID-related goods.
 
• MSMEs intending to start manufacturing these goods.
